parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text: State what is meant by a vector quantity.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
A sphere falls vertically through a liquid that has density 830 kg m^{-3}. The sphere has radius r
and constant velocity v, as shown in Fig. 1.1.
parts.question_text_latex:
A sphere falls vertically through a liquid that has density 830 kg $m^{-3}$. The sphere has radius r
and constant velocity v, as shown in Fig. 1.1.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.question_text:
The drag force D acting on the sphere is given by
D = 6π rηv
where η is a property of the liquid.
Determine the SI base units of η.
SI base units
parts.question_text_latex:
The drag force D acting on the sphere is given by
$D = 6\pi rηv$
where η is a property of the liquid.
Determine the SI base units of η.
SI base units

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.question_text:
State an equation showing the relationship between the magnitudes of the weight W,
drag force D and upthrust U acting on the sphere.

State an equation showing the relationship between the magnitudes of the weight W,
drag force D and upthrust U acting on the sphere.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.question_text:
The volume of the sphere is 4.6 cm^{3}. The drag force D is 0.32 N.
Calculate the weight of the sphere.
weight = N
